title: Library source component diagram
description: The crate's modules. The JSON layer (0.1, 0.2) works on serde_json values and answers UtvResult; the typed layer (typed/) and the native adapters (interop/) sit on top of it. Everything that reads a value goes through model.rs, which validates structurally first, and everything that counts goes through num.rs's checked i128 arithmetic.

components.name: utv crate source
components.responsibility: The library: both layers, re-exported at the crate root.

components.name: Crate root and validation (lib.rs)
components.responsibility: UtvResult, Status, Severity, Diagnostic; strict JSON parsing that rejects duplicate keys; check_envelope, the structural-schema checker, validate_structural, validate_value and validate_gregorian_civil.

components.name: Readers and canonical shapes (model.rs, internal)
components.responsibility: read_civil, read_instant, read_amount and read_rational into checked records (Civil, Amount, Q); canonical JSON for civil values, instants and amounts; the done/fail plumbing that names results.

components.name: Exact arithmetic (num.rs, internal)
components.responsibility: Reduced i128 rationals (Q) and proleptic Gregorian day numbers, every step checked.

components.name: Builders (build.rs)
components.responsibility: date, year_month, time, date_time, in_zone, with_offset, instant, period, posix_seconds, elapsed_seconds, interval and interval_with: canonical shapes, built without judging them.

components.name: ISO 8601 (iso.rs)
components.responsibility: parse_iso and format_iso for ISO 8601 extended format and RFC 3339 / RFC 9557.

components.name: Text form (text.rs)
components.responsibility: parse_text and format_text: points as iso.rs, ISO 8601 periods, bracket intervals, EDTF slash intervals on input.

components.name: Operations (ops.rs)
components.responsibility: fields, add, compare, days_between, posix_seconds_between, contains and overlaps.

components.name: Zone rules (zones.rs)
components.responsibility: Rules (load, parse, from_json, zone_ids), resolve, to_zone and to_offset.

components.name: Typed layer (typed/)
components.responsibility: The 0.3 typed values, Outcome and TemporalContext.

components.name: Structural schema (schema/utv-1.0.schema.json)
components.responsibility: The JSON Schema of utv/1.0, read at compile time.

components.name: serde_json and serde crates
components.responsibility: JSON values (with preserve_order) and the deserializer the strict parser drives.

components.name: regex crate
components.responsibility: The ISO 8601, text-form and schema-pattern regular expressions.
